svg.title: Cortexa completed-vision technical architecture
svg.desc: A detailed technical architecture diagram showing Cortexa clients, typed IPC, trusted Rust services, platform adapters, integrations, storage, gateways, external services, security controls, implementation statuses, and trust boundaries.
svg.text: Local-first control plane · closed trust boundaries · separately approved external processing
Only deterministic local code may grant action authority

g.text: Conceptual research, scheduling and workflow specialists
No recursive delegation or autonomous authority
Closed frames, limits, sequence, terminal state
Terminal local state · late outcomes rejected
Resumable user-visible work with bounded retries
Each requires separate data + security review

svg.text: All inputs remain untrusted; every effect is schema-validated, policy-checked, permission-scoped, approval-bound when required, executed locally, and audited
Cross-cutting controls apply to clients, Rust, storage, adapters, gateway operations and every external integration
Solid = current or external · dashed = planned · dotted = optional/conceptual · repository evidence date: 2026-07-28
